intro.h2: Condo and Home Remodels in South Pasadena and Gulfport
paragraphs: CRUSH IT Renovations LLC handles bathroom remodeling in South Pasadena, along with kitchens, condo makeovers and tile repairs. The company works from Sailboat Key Blvd S, and the owner thanks customers by neighborhood in review replies, from South Pasadena to Gulfport and Harbourside.

Three things stand out in the reviews. Timing: one condo owner needed the work done within a set time frame, and they made it, taking the condo from drab to fab. Price: a patio tile repair came in lower than other bids and was done quickly. Communication: a South Pasadena homeowner calls them very communicative, on time and prompt, and could not be happier with the finished bathroom.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: A South Pasadena homeowner could not be happier with the entire process and the finished bathroom, and called the team professional, communicative, on time and prompt. Bathroom remodeling is one of the two main services listed for CRUSH IT Renovations.

items.blurb: One Gulfport condo went from drab to fab, finished within the time frame the owner needed. Their project photos include a room taken back to fresh drywall with new recessed light cutouts, ready for finishing. Ask about full condo or room makeovers.

about.text: CRUSH IT Renovations LLC is a remodeling company based at 7882 Sailboat Key Blvd S in South Pasadena, Florida. It focuses on kitchen and bathroom remodeling, and reviewers describe condo makeovers and tile repairs too. The owner replies to reviews personally and thanks each customer by neighborhood, from South Pasadena to Gulfport and Harbourside. Customers describe the team as professional, clean, detailed and quick, with prices that came in under other bids. It holds a 4.8 rating from 12 Google reviews.

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (727) 490-9451 or email crushitrenovate@gmail.com and tell them about the bathroom, kitchen or repair you need.

steps.title: Set the timeline
steps.text: Share the time frame you need. One condo owner said the work was finished within the window she asked for.

steps.title: Get a price
steps.text: You get a price for the job before work starts. One customer found it lower than the other bids she collected.

steps.title: Clean, detailed work
steps.text: The work is done with attention to detail and a clean site, and you see the finished room before you sign off.
